name: Launcher Improved
summary: Arrange, group and hide apps in the stock tray
description: Make folders, move apps and hide entries in the stock Sonim apps tray. Quick Settings initializes when opened, not when the tray starts.
author: thooton

changes.text: Use the Sonim Messaging and Music icons and restore AppDrawer artwork [skip ci].
Mods: stock-signed builds for Messages, Launcher and Music; remove OEM signing.
Splice dex into the stock APKs for test deploys.
Distinguish historical mod tests from current signed-device checks.
Verify renamed Messages hook targets in release builds.
Rename Launcher Improved and preserve installed settings.
Consolidate mod builds and require authorized release signatures.
Tray defaults: one integrated 4x3 screen (6 apps + Media, Reading, Tools, Files, System, Applications).
Arranged apps tray: folders, Move, Move to folder, Hide, Rename/Remove folder, Reset layout.
